name: DraftKV
title: Hierarchical Streaming KV Retrieval for Persistent World Models
bullets: Identified a consistency–efficiency trade-off in interactive video world models: historical KV caches preserve scene consistency during revisits, but retrieval, transfer, and attention incur substantial inference overhead.

Developed **DraftKV**, a training-free hierarchical KV retrieval framework combining 3D geometric grounding with low-resolution attention relevance, with theoretical bounds on relevance approximation and retrieval utility.
Designed **Streaming CG-Attention** to overlap host-to-device KV transfer with attention computation using fixed-size GPU staging buffers independent of retrieved context length.

Achieved **3.27× end-to-end speedup and 42.2% peak GPU memory savings** over existing CPU-offloaded KV retrieval methods while improving generation quality and long-term consistency, enabling historical KV retrieval for SolarWM-33B on a single H100.

name: DraftAttention2
title: Low-Resolution-Guided Mixed-Precision Attention for Video Generation
bullets: Identified an efficiency–quality trade-off in few-step video diffusion: sparse attention discards information that is difficult to recover, while uniform low-bit quantization introduces errors in critical visual interactions.

Developed **DraftAttention2**, using dual-path average/max pooling to estimate attention importance and allocate interactions to 16-bit, 8/4-bit, or sparse computation, with theoretical analysis of attention-output error bounds.
Designed a **fused CUDA kernel** integrating quantization, data reordering, and cross-precision online softmax to reduce intermediate writes and redundant memory accesses.
Achieved up to **2.51×/2.60× DiT inference speedups** on HunyuanVideo-13B/MiniMax-H3 and **1.87× speedup** in 8-step video generation while maintaining near-dense generation quality.

name: MosaicAttention
title: Sparse Attention for Multi-View Geometry Transformers
bullets: Identified a limitation of existing sparse attention for multi-view geometry Transformers: overlooking 2D spatial structure makes it difficult to preserve critical cross-view interactions.

Developed **MosaicAttention**, combining 2D average/max pooling with hierarchical sparse routing to allocate computation across layers, further accelerating inference through mixed-precision computation.
Achieved up to **3.12× end-to-end inference speedup** with 128 input views while maintaining or improving accuracy on CO3Dv2 and other multi-view geometry tasks.

name: Mind Dreamer
title: Untethering World-Model Imagination via Active Intervention
bullets: Identified **Historical Tethering** in model-based reinforcement learning: initializing imagination from previously observed states limits exploration of unvisited regions with high learning potential.
Developed **Mind Dreamer**, actively synthesizing high-value latent states as new imagination starting points and guiding exploration through joint assessment of task value and uncertainty.
Achieved **1.67× average and up to 8.8× sample-efficiency gains** over DreamerV3 on DeepMind Control Suite, with higher final returns on multiple sparse-reward tasks.

name: Beyond Token Supervision
title: Semantic Anchors for Latent Reasoning in LLMs
bullets: Identified **semantic drift** caused by the absence of explicit intermediate supervision in continuous latent reasoning.
Developed a semantic-anchor approach using sparse autoencoders to extract features from correct explicit reasoning trajectories and supervise intermediate latent states.
Achieved **11.7% GSM8K accuracy improvement** over the COCONUT latent-reasoning baseline.
